title: Cancer on his lip, 1926, and joining Charlie Elgar at the Savoy
summary: He leaves Oliver in February 1926 for treatment of lip cancer, is off the horn two years, then plays with Charlie Elgar at the Savoy Ballroom with Manuel Perez.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians
